parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: A client-generated key per logical submit (a retry reuses it); 1-128 printable ASCII characters, sent once (a UUID is conventional but not required). Missing is 400 idempotency-key-required; empty-invalid, repeated or non-printable is 400 idempotency-key-invalid. The key is global across operations: a repeated key with the same operation and inputs replays the stored answer with Idempotency-Replayed true; the same key with another operation or other inputs is 409 idempotency-key-reused. A failed request leaves no claim behind, so its key can be retried.
